Investment Objective
The objective of the scheme is long term growth of 
capital, through a portfolio with a target allocation of 
100% equity by aiming at being as diversified across 
various industries and/ or sectors as its chosen 
benchmark index, Nifty 100 TRI. The secondary objective is 
income generation and distribution of IDCW. The Scheme 
does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There can be no 
assurance that the objective of the Scheme will be 
achieved.
